scope: Proposition 6.3 (Removal of coefficient differentiation) of the manuscript “Virasoro Constraints under Projectivization” (preprints/Virasoro-Constraints-under-Projectivization-October-5-2026/virasoro-constraints-under-projectivization.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 065 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 573917aea43c708a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The operators in (6.7) satisfy [Pi, λ] = 0, [Li, λ] = zPi, [Ga, Pi] = [Ga, Li] = 0. (6.8) In particular Pi and Mi = Li − zPi∂λ are matrix series, without coefficient differentiation. The operator Di = PiGa − λ z Li (6.9) differentiates only in z and satisfies PiDi = DiPi = Di.
